title: Cloud Test Machine power
summary: Cloud Test Machines start by instance id under their host lease and wait for SSH on the unchanged registered MagicDNS name. Each cloud Test Machine names the project whose provider credentials power it. Yoke records a marker after it starts a stopped machine. On the last release the client stops only a marked machine under its host lease, clearing the marker after the provider confirms the stop. A queued handoff preserves custody and the marker. A manual stop and restart can leave the marker set. All hosts, Macs included, manually install Tailscale, join the operator tailnet and register their MagicDNS name. Windows joins unattended on Windows only. EC2 retains auto-assigned public IPv4 only while running, without Elastic IPs. Azure creates and attaches a Standard public IP before start. During shutdown Azure deallocates the VM, detaches the public IP from the NIC and deletes it. The NIC supplies outbound on the private subnet; NSG admits key-only OpenSSH from anywhere, with desktops forwarded. Power never reads or writes the registered host. HostKeyAlias remains the cloud instance id. Host-rebind is retired with a per-surface client floor and function_version_skew. Target-change refusal and proven settings remain. Rollout joins first, deploys second, registers MagicDNS third, deletes the permanent Azure IP last. The operator approved manual setup; tailnet policy, tags, key machinery and IaC are outside this item. Rebuild removes the old device before joining again to avoid a name suffix, and verifies/clears the SSH pin; reset never changes Tailscale. Browser authorization, desktop-access and yoke test-machine exec acquire a host lease or borrow the caller's own, power on before their host work, and release only their own lease after cleanup; exec under a foreign lease refuses test_machine_leased without powering on. A borrow of the caller's own lease that its walking or awaiting-review walk holds heartbeats that walk before and after the command through test_machine.lease_execution_heartbeat, so an exec-driven walk is not reaped stale-heartbeat; acquired leases, other states and other sessions' walks heartbeat nothing, and a server without the function is named on stderr while the command still runs. Authorized steering assistance preserves the foreign lease.
